run_agent_scenario: run an ARESimulationAgent scenario with a given Scenario object and optional notification system
initialize_agent_tools: initialize agent tools from a Scenario by converting AppTool instances to AppToolAdapter wrappers
configure_system_prompt: configure the agent system prompt with notification descriptions and current date placeholders
execute_agent_loop: execute the synchronous agent loop processing user messages and environment notifications until max turns
manage_sub_agents: discover and configure sub-agents nested within tools by setting parent references and time managers
